content: Sony is retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC on December 10th. Sony says it will notify users directly about the shutdown. The app allowed PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers to stream certain games on PC, but according to Sony, not many people are using that perk: > With a very small number of eligible PlayStation Plus Premium members (less than 0.4%) using the PlayStation Plus app on PC, making this change allows us to focus on enhancing high-quality experiences that more of our members want to use. As a result, the PlayStation Plus cloud streaming app on PC will no longer be available. PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers can still stream games on a console or on the PlayStation Portal. Sony’s decision to take the PC app offline follows reports earlier this year saying Sony is pulling back from PC and no longer plans to release PC ports of PlayStation exclusives.

chineseContent: 索尼将于 12 月 10 日停用 PC 版 PlayStation Plus 应用程序。索尼表示将直接通知用户有关关闭的信息。该应用程序允许 PlayStation Plus Premium 订户在 PC 上串流某些游戏，但根据索尼的说法，没有多少人使用该福利：> 由于只有极少数符合资格的 PlayStation Plus Premium 会员（不到 0.4%）在 PC 上使用 PlayStation Plus 应用程序，这一更改使我们能够专注于增强更多会员想要使用的高质量体验。因此，PC 上的 PlayStation Plus 云流媒体应用程序将不再可用。 PlayStation Plus Premium 订阅者仍然可以在主机或 PlayStation Portal 上串流游戏。索尼决定将 PC 应用程序下线是在今年早些时候有报道称索尼将退出 PC 市场并不再计划发布 PlayStation 独占游戏的 PC 端口之后。
